tei:div.tei:p: 533) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: bka' srung srog gi spu gri'i rtsa sgrub phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs: 534)na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye: rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis: srung ma lus dang grib ma bzhin: 'grogs phyir sgrub thabs rim pa bstan: rin chen snod du gtor ma dang: 'bru sna sha sna snying sna sogs: dgos pa'i yo byad 'du bar bya: nam mkha' mdzod du byin gyis brlabs: rang nyid lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: rang mdun khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong: kṣaḥlas drang srong rā hu la: sku mdog nag cing khro gtum 'bar: dbu dgu bya rog mgo dang bcu: phyag bzhi ral gri rgyal mtshan dang: mda' gzhu dgra bgegs snying la 'gengs: sku smad gdug pa sprul du 'khyil: lus po thams cad mig gis gang: me rlung dug rlangs na bun 'phro: gdong mo bzhi dang gza' chen brgyad: rgyu skar tshogs dang dregs pa'i sde: sprul dang yang sprul tshogs kyis bskor: thugs srog kṣa:la sngags kyis bskor: oṃ nā ga raksha ra hu la hūṃ dzaḥ nyer gcig bzla: hūm̐ kṣaḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: drang srong chen po spyan 'dren no: gza' bdud 'khor 'das gshegs su gsol: srog gi spu gri gshegs su gsol: khrag mtsho bam gyi 535)gdan la bzhugs: bstan srung chen por phyag 'tshal lo: bdag gi srung mar mnga' gsol lo: rang byung bhandha'i snod nang du: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs: dmar gtor dgu bskor 'bru sna dang: chu sna sman sna sha sna'i rigs: dgra bo'i sha khrag rus gsum dang: don snying dbang po rnam pa lnga: ri yi dbang lnga la sogs pa'i: mthun rdzas spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis: drang srong gza' bdud nag po mchod: sring mo gdong mo mched bzhi mchod: gza' brgyad rgyu skar nyer brgyad mchod: yang 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad mchod: gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskangs: rnal 'byor lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: ma g.yel ma 'gyangs phrin las sgrubs:

sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: bstan la gnod cing sgrub la 'tshe: dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus pa: 'grang med lto zhal drag pos sod: bla yid sems gsum zhal du bstab: sha khrag rus par longs su spyod: rjes shul med par rdul du rlog dus las ma 'da' sa ma ya: ci bcol phrin las 536)'grub par mdzod: de ltar rgyun du brtson gyur na: bka' srung lus dang grib bzhin 'khor: gang brtsams phrin las 'grub par nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa 'di nyid rnal 'byor las 'brel rtsal gyi bzhed skong du kun bzang bde skyong dag mos bris pa'o/ kṣa: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: drang srong chen po gshegs su gsol: gdong mo mched bzhi gshegs su gsol: rgyu skar nyer brgyad gshegs su gsol: lhan srin sde spyod gshegs su gsol: ma lus 'khor 'das gshegs su gsol: khrag mtsho bam gyi gdan la bzhugs: thugs mthun phyi nang mchod pa dang: ra rog dbang lnga dgra bgegs snying: sha sna 'bru sna dbang lnga'i gsur: snang srid mchod pa'i rgyan du 'bul: gsol lo mchod do thugs dam dang: dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: rnal 'byor lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: gang bcol phrin las thogs med sgrubs: ma 'da' badzra sa ma ya: oṃ raksha rā hu la i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: 'di la rgyus du brtson gyur na: phrin las gang 'dod thogs med 'grub: rtags mtshan lag tu longs dang gsal: the tshom med do sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: ces pa 'di yang dad ldan dge btsun shī la ratnas nan cher yang yang 537)bskul ngor kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos shar mar bris pa dge'o// kṣa: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: drang srong chen po spyan 'dren no: dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: ma lus 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: dam nyams dgra bo rdul du rlog: rab 'byams phrin las myur 'grub mdzod:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa 'di nyid rnal 'byor pa las 'brel rtsal gyi bzhed skong du bde ba'i rdo rjes brda las bsgyur ba'o// chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: dregs pa rnam gsum gsol bsdus ni: gtor skyems sogs byin gyis brlabs: rang nyid lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: hūm̐ bhyoḥ sngon tshe rgyal dbang padma'i spyan snga ru: gter gyi srung mar khas blangs dam bcas pa: dbyings kyi rje mo dam can rdo rje legs: gza' mchog chen po sprul 'khor bka' sdod bcas: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas dmar gyi gtor ma 'bul: gsol mchod bstod do gang bsam yongs 'grub shog: ces brjod phrin las rab 'byams 'grub par nges: sa ma ya: zhes pa tshul rdor bzhed pa ltar bde rdor gyis smras pa'o// yang: kyai: dad 538)pa dang ni dam tshig gis: dregs pa rnam gsum spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: dgyes bzhes rab 'byams phrin las mdzod: ces dang: yang: hrīḥ dam tshig dbang gis bka' srung dbyings nas bskul: mchod gsol bstod do phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: ces so: dregs pa rnam gsum bstod pa ni: bhyo: dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las mthu mnga' ba: log 'dren bdud sde 'joms mdzad drag por bzhengs: dregs pa rnam gsum sprul 'khor bka' sdod bcas: ma lus 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: mi mkho dgu mkho shī la badzra ngor: bde ba'i rdo rjes gang shar yig ris bris: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: gnod sbyin srog bdag chen po'i gsol mchod bdud las rnam rgyal phrin las myur 'grub bzhugs so: na mo padma kro ta ye: phud skyems dmar gtor sha sna mchod rdzas bshams: nam mkha' mdzod kyis byin brlabs bdud rtsir bsgyur: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal ldan pa'i ngang: sha chen dud pas bdug cing 'di skad do: bhyo kṣa: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: bka' srung gnyen po spyan 'dren no:

dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas 539)nas: gnod sbyin 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: rgyan ldan dga' mdzes srog 'khor dang: gnyis su med par bzhugs su gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang: thugs mthun spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis: gnod sbyin 'khor 'das gsol lo mchod: thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig: dbang lnga'i me tog sha chen dud: nyams pa'i sha khrag srog dbugs kyis: gnod sbyin 'khor 'das gsol lo mchod: thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig: sman sna 'bru sna go mtshon rigs: khyi dmar tsitta go re yis: gnod sbyin= thugs dam= 'dod yon dmar gtor skyems phud dang: yid sprul mthun pa'i rdzas mchog gis: gnod sbyin= thugs dam= khyed las phrin las bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis srungs: bstan 'dzin tshe bsrings 'dus sde rgyas: rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po'i: lus dang grib bzhin sdong grogs mdzod: mi 'dod 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi: chos srid mnga' thang longs spyod rgyas: 'gro ba'i snang sems dbang du bsdus: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: bka' dam gnyen po dpang btsugs la: rab 'byams 540)phrin las lhun grub mdzod: ma 'da' badzra sa ma ya: de ltar rgyun du gsol gyur na: bka' srung lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: phrin las gang 'dod 'grub par nges: the tshom med do nyams su longs: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams la 'di ma 'phrad: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: gu hya: : ces pa'ang o rgyan dngos snang gsang gter rgya mtsho'i lde mig mchog gyur yid bzhin nor bu las 'brel pa'i bzhed skong du dus mtha'i gter ming kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos rin chen shog ser las dag par bshus pa'o// dge'o// ka dag stong dbyings 'og min dur khrod nas: kha dog rā ga'i mdangs ngom lha chen po: ga ler mda' dar srog 'khor rten la bzhugs: nga yis 'bod do gnod sbyin shan pa dmar:

ca co'i tshig tsam ma yin nges pa'i don: cha lugs gnod sbyin drag khros he ru ka: ja chang phud skyems dgra bgegs sha khrag 'bul: nya rgyas zla ltar zhal bzang bdag la ston: ta tha ga ta'i bstan srung chen po khyod: tha tshig gnyan las ma 'da' phrin las mdzod: da nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar: na da'i sgra yis khyod bsten khyod bsgrubs pas: pa ra 541)mi ta'i snying po mthar phyin nas: pha rol gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol: ba khams lta bur 'gro don mtha' rgyas nas: ma lus bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod: tsa than rta mchog glang po ma he dang: tsha mngar zas nor la sogs dbang du bsdus: dza ba'i grogs dang 'khor slob skyong mdzod la: wa dang gcan gzan gzugs 'gros sna tshogs 'bul: zhwa dmar bstan pa gnod pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: za ngu gyis la rjes lhag med par mdzod: 'a 'ur che ba'i dam nyams gang yin kun: ya ma rā dza'i khram la thebs par mdzod: ra me shwa ra'i gnas su rnam shes spor: la yog mi 'gyang dam nyams dgra la phobs: sha khrag rus pa rngams zas khyur mid thongs: sa steng 'di na 'gran bral khyod lta bu: ha ra la sogs bstan dgra'i gshed po che: a ti'i bstan srung rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: bka' srung gnod sbyin chen po khyod la bstod: de ltar bstod cing sgrub mchod byas pa'i mthus: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: gang 'dod phrin las ma lus myur 'grub mdzod: bka' dang 542)dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya: ces gnod sbyin chen po'i dgyes zhal cung zad ngom pa'i tshe su kha badzra gyis bris pa'o// rdo rje legs pa'-i gsol bsdus ni: hūm̐: rgyal dbang padma thod phreng bka' nyan pa: dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs pa rtsal: mchod 'khor sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes: rnal 'byor bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i las: thogs med myur du sgrubs shig sa ma ya:

zhes pas nan du gsol gyur na: bka' srung bran khol the tshom med: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa 'di yang rnal 'byor las 'brel pas gsung bskul ngor gter ston su kha badzra gyis brda las bsgyur ba'o// hūm̐: 'dod pa'i rgyal po he ru ka: dbang phyug chen po 'khor dang bcas: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma bzhes: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub pa dang: rnal 'byor bsam don lhun grub mdzod: bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// bhyo: ma gcig rgyal ba kun gyi yum: ma mo e ka dzā ṭi ma: ma tshogs 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs: ma tshang med pa'i mchod gtor bzhes: ma g.yel lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: 543)ma yi tha tshig ji bzhin du: rnal 'byor 'dod don lhun grub mdzod: su kha'i ming gis so: bhyo: chos dbyings kun tu bzang mo'i sgyu 'phrul gar: gsang sngags gnyer 'dzin rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas skyems gtor 'di shes la: brtse ba'i tshul gyis mgon skyabs sdong grogs mdzod: nad gdon zhi dang tshe bsod yon tan rgyas: khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra bgegs rdul brlags nas: rnal 'byor bsam don ma lus myur 'grub mdzod: khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni: rnal 'byor zab gter spel ba'i grogs: che ge'i bla yid sems gsum bsdus: rnal 'byor bdag gi dbang gyur nas: tshe bsrings bstan pa phyogs kun rgyas: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod: ces pa'ang su kha'i ming gis so// ge sar bsangs bsdus bde legs 'byung gnas bzhugs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bsangs mchod 'di: rig gsum sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul seng chen rgyal: bka' 'khor las byed srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes la bsam pa'i don kun 544) 'grub par mdzod: ces bde ba'i rdo rje'i ming gis grangs tshad gsog skabs le los bskul nas nyung bsdus 'di bris pa'o// hūm̐: dag snang las ge sar gsol mchod 'dod don myur 'grub bzhugs:

na mo padma kro dha ye: gang zhig rnal 'byor ldan pa yis: seng chen dpa' bo mchod pa'i thabs: 'dod don myur 'grub 'di ru bstan: gser skyems la sogs ci 'byor bshams: nam mkha' mjod kyis byin gyis brlabs: oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: de nas gsol mchod bya ba ni: hūm̐: rigs gsum pad 'byung sprul pa seng chen rgyal: ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul sprul 'khor dpung: ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la: gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyen po bskang: bdag gi 'dod don ma lus kun 'grub mdzod: khyad par tshe chos bsod nams dbang thang la: bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams: ming tsam med par thal ba'i rdul du rlog: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya: ci bcol phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod: ces brjod gang bsam 'grub par nges: sa ma ya: ces dad ldan mi dbang ldan ming 'dzin pas rin chen gnyis pa'i skyes bcas bskul ngo mi ldog tsam du 545)su kha badzra gyis bris pa'o// dge'o// dag snang las ge sar gsol mchod bsdus pa bzhugs: na mo padma kro dha ye: dkar gsum gser skyems phud bshams la: ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud rtsir bsgyur: lha yi sa ma ti yi ngang: hūm̐: rigs gsum padma'i sgyu 'phrul seng chen rgyal: dgra bla bcu gsum wor ma'i tshogs dang bcas: 'dir gshegs dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs: phyi nang gsang mchod 'dod yon mchod pa bzhes: rnal 'byor las kun thogs med 'grub pa dang: zab gter bstan pa mtha' rgyas phrin las mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: ces brjod grangs ldan brtson nus na: gang bsam myur du 'grub par nges: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa 'di yang bde ba'i go chas gdams bzhin bde chen bde pa'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o/ nyer spyod kyis mchod la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: thog med sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang: 'gro ba'i don du gzugs skur bzhengs:

bdud kyi dpung 'joms dgra ba'i rgyal: seng chen sprul 'khor bcas la bstod: bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyi nyams ris so// dge'o// 546) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: dregs pa yongs 'dus za ngu dgra bo phung byed gnam lcags thog mda' zab mo bzhugs: na mo padma kro dha ye: phyi rabs rnal 'byor gang dag gis: nges med dben khod ma gnas tshe: ma nyes pa la dgra byung na: dmar gtor skyems bcas phud rgod bran: lta ba'i gding bskyed ngang gis phros: lha yi ting 'dzin ldan pa'i ngang: hūm̐ bhyoḥ pho rgyud che btsan tshogs kyi bdag: mgon po'i dmag dpung dgra la rgyugs: dgra bo'i yul khams cham la phobs: dgra sha za ba'i za ngu gyis: dgra khrag 'thung ba'i za ngu gyis: dgra rus mur ba'i= dgra lpags gyon pa'i= ming nas 'bod pa'i= zas nor brlag pa'i= che brgyud brlag pa'i= chung brgyud gcod pa'i= dam nyams dgra bo sdig can ni: bdun brgyud tshun chad ma bzhag par: za ngu gyis la lhag med mdzod: dbyings kyi rje mo e ka tsa: mchod sde lnga dang g.yu sgron ma: ngas nus sha za kha mo che: ma mo'i dmag dpung dgra la bhyoḥ dgra bo'i yum khams= mdzod: gnod sbyin shan dmar rdo rje legs: gza' bdud dug gi spu gri che: dregs pa 547)rnam gsum dgra la bhyo: dgra bo'i yul khams cham la phobs: dgra sha= mdzod: lha chen dbang phyug srid pa'i bdag: btsan rgod chen po srog gi gshed: zhing skyong mgon dkar a pa ra: 'khor 'das dmag dpung dgra la bhyo: dgra bo'i yul khams= mdzod: 'jig 'das srung ma rgya mtsho dang: sde brgyad dmag dpung dgra la bhyo: dgra bo'i yul khams= mdzod: bka' srung gter srung dregs pa'i tshogs: gtang rag yin no za ngu mdzod: za skal gtad do lhag med thongs: bka' srung mi btsan kho re btsan: dam nyams dgra bo zas su gsol: rnal 'byor rnams ni brnyas shing 'phrog: dam nyams dgra bo zas su gsol: dkor nor longs spyod brku zhing bcom:

dam nyams dgra bo zas su gsol: za skal yin no khams ma chung: dgra bo'i phung khams skye mched dang: mnga' thang longs spyod bsod nams dpal: bka' srung dam can gtang rag mdzod: nad kha rims kha dgra la sgyur: ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: mtshon kha zor kha dgra la bsgyur: sri ngan byad 548)kha dgra la sgyur: bdud kyi bar chad dgra la sgyur: bzlog go sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: thams cad bhyo bzlog sa ma ya: bcol ba'i las la mthu ma zhan: dam tshig gnyen po las ma 'da': sangs rgyas bstan srungs bstan 'dzin skyongs: ma g.yel phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: ces gtor skyems dgra bo'i phyogs su mchod: dgra bo shul med brlag par nges: dus la ma babs bskul mi rung: za skam dus la babs pa'i tshe: myur mgyogs nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra: drag shul gnam lcags thog las 'phags: zab bo gsang bar nyams su longs: dam nyams rnams la a thaṃ rgya: rnal 'byor bstan pa'i bcas su shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa'ang 'khrul snang la srid pa gsal byed yin zer ba zhig gis brdas bskul tshe drag sngags spu gri'i rgyud las zob brdzun su kha badzra gyis yid bzhin nor bu'i bzhed skong du dgos gal dang bstun te khol du phyung ba'o// dge'o// sa skyong lha reg gnyan rtse'i gsol mchod 'dod dgu'i dpal ster bzhugs: rin chen snod du dkar gsum dang: dmar gtor la sogs 'byor rdzas bsags: skyems phud gtsang sbyar nus pas brlabs: lha yi ting 'dzin ldan pa'i ngang: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: kyai: rgyal dbang 549)padma'i tha tshig la gnas pa'i: drag shul stobs ldan lha reg gnyan rtse dang: sprul 'khor dpung dang yum sras bka' sdod bcas: 'dir gshegs bsangs dang mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs: rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs dang: khyad par thugs mthun rdzas dang bsang gis brngan: 'khor 'das gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang:

gnas mgron dam tshig gnyen po dpang btsugs la: las gang bcol ba'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: phyi yi mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs mtshon kha bzlog: nang du chags che 'thab rtsod mi mthun sol: khyad par yul gzhi srung zhing sdong grogs dang: kha rje dbang thang rlung rta gong 'phel mdzod: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin rnams kyi bka' dam bzhin: las bzhi'i phrin las ma lus bsgrub pa dang: dus rnams rtag tu lus dang grib bzhin du: dbyer med gang bsam 'dod don lhun grub mdzod: ma g.yel rdo rje'i dam tshig dpang btsug go: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zhes pa'ang dus 'dzin shing glang lo'i zla 9tshes 15nam gung nyag gi dus gter srung 550)lta reg gnyan rtse yin skad pa'i mi dkar rta dkar can zhig gis smras pa bde ba'i rdo rjes 'khrul snang yig ris su bgyis pa'o/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrīḥ kyai: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: yul gzhi srung mdzad drag shul can: lha reg gnyan rtse yum sras 'khor: phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi: sprul 'khor bka' sdod bcas pa la: gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskangs: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la: srung skyob bsam don lhun grub mdzod: khyad par zab gter sgo 'phar 'byed: mtha' rgyas yun brtan phrin las mdzod: ma 'da' badzra sa ma ya: ces pa 'di yang dgos gal dang bstun te bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// dge'o// srung ma spyi la gces pa'i phrin bcol dpag bsam snye ma bzhugs: na mo padma kā ra ye: rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis: srung ma gsol mchod byas pa'i mthar: 'dod don phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' dam la gnas pa'i: zab gter yongs rdzogs bka' yi gnyer 'dzin pa: gnod sbyin chen po shan pa yab yum dang: sprul 'khor las byed pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas: 551)ma lus bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol: khyed rnams bsten cing sgrub mchod byas pa yis:

rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod don yongs 'grub mdzod: khyad par dmigs pa'i yul gyur skyes bu yi: blo yid mos pa bdag dbang bsgyur ba dang: 'gal rkyen mi mthun bar chad dbyings su bzlog: sku tshe mdzad phrin yar ngo'i zla bzhin spel: don gnyis lhun grub phrin las mtha' rgyas mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya: bcol ba'i las 'di ma 'gyang myur 'grub mdzod: ces brjod gang bsam 'dod don 'grub: the tshom med do sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa'ang bsod sprul rin po che'i thugs bzhed 'grub phyir dgos gal dang bstun te dbyings snang ḍā ki'i brda las kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mos dag par phab pa'o// 552) 553) gter srung lha rabs gnyen po g.yul rgyal gyi gsol mchod phrin las lhun grub bzhugs: gu ru he ru ka la 'dud: ja chang skyems phud gtsang sbyar dang: 'bru zan la sogs ci 'byor bsags: swa bhā wa yis stong par sbyangs: nam mkha' mdod kyis 'dzod dgur spel: sa ma ya: kyai: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas srog snying phul: srid pa'i lha rabs gnyen po yi: sprul pa dmag dpon chen po ni: dbyi shod sa 'dzin dgra bla'i gtso: ru 'dren sprul 'khor dpung tshogs bcas: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan gyis 'bod: ma thogs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dngos 'byor yid las sprul pa yi: thugs mthun phyi nang gsang mchod bzhes: khyad par dam nyams bstan dgra'i sde: nye'am ring ba gar gnas kyang: khyed kyis mi mthong gang yang med: srog gi mar me dbyings su snubs: sha khrag srog snying lhag med rol: zab gter bstan pa rgyas pa dang: bstan 'dzin tshe srings bar chad sol: rab 'byams phrin las lhun grub mdzod: khyad par yul 'di'i dgon gnas dang: bla ma dge 'dun 554)grwa tshan dang: dpon sde 'bangs 'khor thams cad kyi: tshe dpal 'byor pa rgyas pa dang: lo legs 'bru 'phel rta phyugs spel:

rigs rgyud bu dang dpal g.yang stsol: phan tshun mthun cing 'khrugs rtsod zhi: rdzogs ldan dus kyi bskal pa bzhin: 'jig rten bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar: gang bsam 'dod pa'i don kun sgrubs: thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma ya: zhes yul skyong kho rang gi ngor gnas mgron gyi dam tshig la bsam nas bde ba'i ming gis nyams snang la bris pa'o// dge'o// 555)dag snang ye shes drwa pa las: klu bsangs 'dod dgu'i dpal ster bzhugs: na mo padma kā ra ye: skye dgu'i bsod nams spel ba dang: rkyen sel dngos grub 'byung ba'i thabs: bsang mchod rim pa 'di ru bkod: bzang shing tsan ldan dkar dmar dang: spang spos sba snyug nya sbrid dang: klu shing klu sman dkar gsum rigs: mngar gsum dza ti pha la sogs: ba dmar 'o ma'i bcud kyis gtams: rang nyid klu dbang rgyal po yi: ting 'dzin dang ldan 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams rang bzhin stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang mdun du: rin chen sna tshogs sa gzhi'i dbus: raṃ las ye shes me dpung klong: ting 'dzin las sprul mchod pa'i rdzas: dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru bcud dang: klu shing sman dang dar zab rigs: rin chen gsum dang gos dar nor: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod don lnga: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: rgyal srid sna bdun mkho dgu'i dpal: ma tshang med pa'i gter chen po: nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs pa'i: zag med ye shes bdud rtsier bsgyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum gyis spel: de bas bsang mgron spyan 556)'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin rnam dag zhing khams nas: brgyud gsum bla ma yi dam dang: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bsang mchod gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bka' srung pho rgyud mo rgyud dang: nor lha gter bdag rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bsang mchod gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: khyad par klu mtsho phyug mo la:

gnas pa'i skye dgu'i dpal gyi bdag: klu rgyal dung skyong dkar po ni: phyag gnyis padma nor bu 'dzin: gang 'dod dngos grub stsol ba'i lha: sprul 'khor ma lus thams cad kun: bsang mchod gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: byang chub sems dpa'i phrin las gar: klu chen brgyad dang yang 'khor dang: rang rang dgyes sde btsun mo sras: ma lus bsang mchod gnas 'dir gshegs: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'dzin med rang gsal chen por bzhugs: sgo gsum dang ba chen po yis: bstan pa srung phyir phyag 'tshal lo: ting nge 'dzin las rab sprul pa'i: rtsi bcud shing rtsi klu sman dang: dar zab 'bru nor longs spyod dang: dkar gsum mngar gsum rin chen rigs: nyer spyod 'dod yon sna tshogs dang: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: 'dod rgu'i dpal 557)yon phun tshogs gter: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul te: gos dkar mo yi klong du 'bul: dam tshig sgrol mas rab bskyod cing: zag med dud sprin bsam mi khyab: ye shes bdud rtsi'i bsang mchod 'dis: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma bsangs: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug bsangs: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: byin rlabs ye shes dngos grub stsol: chos skyong bstan srung dam can bsangs: klu rgyal mi mgon rig ldan dang: mtha' yas 'jog po dga' bo bsangs: nor rgyas padma chen po dang: padma rgyal sogs 'khor bcas bsangs: yang 'khor gnyan dang sa bdag dang: klu phran ma lus 'khor 'das bsangs: skyes pa'i shing dang 'bab pa'i chu: brtan pa'i sa rdo ri brag la: gnas pa'i bsod nams nor gyi bdag: ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa bsangs: zag med bdud rtsi'i bsang mchod 'dis: rmugs grib 'khon dang dme grib sogs: thams cad byang zhing bsangs gyur cig: zag med 558)bdud rtsi'i bsang mchod 'dis: thugs dam bskang la nyams chag bshags: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor 'das la: nad med bde dang tshe bsod rgyas:

'bru nor longs spyod mnga' thang 'phel: gnag lug rta dar zas dgu'i bcud: rigs brgyud snyan grags btsan phyug sogs: 'dod dgu'i dngos grub char ltar stsol: 'jig rten bde dang lo legs shing: phyugs rnams 'phel zhing don 'grub pa: yid la bsam pa kun 'grub cing: bde skyid chos 'phel bkra shis shog: bsang mchod mgron rnams rang gnas gshegs: rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsod nams longs spyod spel ba'i phyir: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: bsang mchod phul ba'i bsod nams kyis: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas shing: de 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang rgyas: 'gro khams bde ba'i dpal thob shog: ces dang gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs brjod: 'dir brtson skal ldan gang su dag: bsod nams longs spyod gong 'phel nas: bkra shis bde legs 'byung bar nges : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa 'di yang 7skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa mchog sprul sna tshogs rang grol gyi bka' bskul spyi bor son tshe 'khor 'bangs tha shal ba 559)bde skyong dbang mos ser dgon dben khrod nas yar tshes dge bar dag par bris pa'o// dge'o// gter gnas ni/ dbus phyogs su gnas chen thams cad kyi gtso bo/ gangs ti se/ gangs ri thod dkar/ brag yer pa dang gsum/ zal lo sgang du gnas chen gsum ni/ rma rgyal/ sprel rdzong*/ mtsho sngon no/ rdzong gsum ni/ padma rdzong*/ mkha' 'gro rdzong*/ rdo rje rdzong ngo*/ gnas phran gsum ni/ stong ra brag dkar/ shar la brag dkar/ yang shar brag dkar ro/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gsum ni/ sku'i gnas rdo rje rdzong*/ gsung gi gnas padma rdzong*/ thugs kyi gnas yar klungs shel brag go/ zhes pa'ang shī la badzra'i ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes so/ 560)
